title: Ultrafast charge transfer dynamics in lead sulfide quantum dots probed with resonant Auger spectroscopy at the lead M-edge
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,16894-16900
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00479A, Paper

Elin Cartwright, Fredrik O. L. Johansson, Tamara Sloboda, Birgit Kammlander, Andreas Lindblad, Ute B. Cappel
We investigate charge transfer dynamics in PbS quantum dots of varying sizes, bulk PbS, and PbI2 reference samples using Resonant Auger- (RAS) and Core-Hole Clock Spectroscopy (CHCS).
